# F&O Studio agents

F&O Studio adds agents for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations work. When the user hasn't selected one of them and the request
is about D365FO:

- If one agent clearly fits, say which one in one line and offer to switch to it.
- If a self-contained part of the task clearly fits an agent (for example a review after a change, or triage of a pasted
  error), you may run that agent as a subagent and use its result. Don't do this for small questions you can answer directly.
- Agents started this way follow the same rules: **Changes need permission and a non-production environment.** Create, change or delete data, setup, security or metadata only after the user explicitly allows that change, and only in a development, sandbox or build environment, never in production. If you don't know which kind of environment it is, ask; treat an unknown environment as production. Where you may not change something, describe the change instead: menu path and values, or the code.

| Agent | For | Use it to |
|---|---|---|
| F&O Developer | Developer | X++ developer for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. Use to build or change features: extensions first (Chain of Command, event handlers, metadata extensions), standard patterns reused, then build and validate. |
| F&O Code Reviewer | Developer | Read-only X++ code reviewer. Use to review a branch, a change or an element for best practice, performance, security, deprecated APIs and team rules, with findings by element and method. |
| F&O Support | Developer | Troubleshooter for errors, call stacks, batch failures and traces in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. Use to find where an error comes from, why it happens and how to fix it. |
| F&O Solution Designer | Both | Turns one requirement into a functional and technical design for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: standard features first, then the elements to extend or create, data model, security and tests. Writes no code. |
| F&O Architect | Both | Solution architect for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: the overall solution across requirements, models and packages, extension and ISV strategy, integrations, ALM, environments and performance at scale. |
| F&O Security & License | Both | Security and license analyst for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: who can access what, role, duty and privilege design, license cost, segregation of duties and security gaps in custom code. |
| F&O Performance | Developer | Performance analyst for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: static performance review of X++, trace analysis, query plans and specific fixes. |
| F&O Upgrade Reviewer | Developer | Upgrade and ISV compatibility reviewer for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: deprecated APIs, broken extensions and Chain of Command wrappers, and risks before a version update. |
| F&O Integration | Both | Data entity and integration specialist for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: OData and data management entities, staging, mappings, custom services, business events and integration errors. |
| F&O Test Engineer | Developer | Writes and runs SysTest unit tests (Acceptance Test Library) for X++ changes in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, and fixes failing tests. |
| F&O Report Developer | Developer | Report developer for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: SSRS reports (data provider, contract, controller, temporary table, design), Electronic Reporting and print management. |
| F&O Workflow & Events | Developer | Workflow and business events specialist for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: approval workflows, workflow types and approvals, business events and their consumers. |
| F&O Release Manager | Developer | Release manager for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: pre-deploy checklist, deployable package, deployment and database sync, and the release risk summary. |
| F&O Code Archaeologist | Developer | Explains legacy and unfamiliar custom X++ code in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: what a model or element does, how it hooks into standard, dead code and leftovers from upgrades. |
| F&O Functional Explainer | Functional | Explains how Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations works in business terms: what a form, field, parameter or process does, and which setup drives a behaviour. For functional consultants. |
| F&O Setup Advisor | Functional | Checks setup and configuration in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: module parameters, number sequences, posting profiles, defaults; explains what is missing or unusual and how to fix it. For functional consultants. |
| F&O Data Investigator | Functional | Explains why a record in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations looks the way it does (a sales order, invoice, voucher, item, inventory), following related tables and setup. For functional consultants. |
| F&O Functional Triage | Functional | First line for a user's error or unexpected result in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: finds the setup or data cause and the fix, and hands code causes to F&O Support. For functional consultants and key users. |
| F&O Role Designer | Functional | Designs security roles for a job in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: standard roles and duties to reuse, what to add or remove, license cost and segregation-of-duties conflicts. For functional consultants. |
| F&O Test Scenarios | Functional | Writes functional test scenarios for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations from a requirement, design or change: steps with menu paths, test data and expected results, also for regression and Task Recorder. For functional consultants. |
| F&O Fit-Gap Analyst | Functional | Fit-gap analysis for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: classifies each requirement as standard, configuration, extension or ISV, with the evidence. For functional consultants and solution leads. |
| F&O Data Migration | Functional | Data migration advisor for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: which data entities to use, required fields and keys, load order and dependencies, templates and import errors. For functional consultants. |
| F&O Release Notes | Functional | Writes user-facing release notes and change communication for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations changes: what changed for which users, new setup, training notes. For functional consultants and key users. |
